 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Suman Shyam
 Order
Date : 29/11/2024  Heard Mr. K.N. Choudhury, learned senior counsel assisted by Mr. M. Ahmed,
learned counsel for the writ petitioner. Perused the averments made in the writ petition. 
The petitioner, who was appointed under Regulation 3(f) of the Assam Public Service Commission (Limitation of Functions) Regulations, 1951, is serving as a Drug Inspector at Kamrup (Metro). 
Referring to the Government notification dated 24/11/2024, Mr. Choudhury submits that by transferring and posting the private respondent no. 7 at Kamrup (M), the respondents are indirectly making an attempt to disturb the petitioner's service merely because he was the petitioner in WP(C)
Page No.# 3/3 2812/2017 wherein, a direction had been issued by this Court on 24/11/2023 to revisit and re- consider the prayer made by the petitioner for regularization of his service.
Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 29 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71574239/
2 Mr. B. Gogoi, learned Standing Counsel, Health Department, Assam, seeks time till 04/12/2024 to obtain preliminary instruction responding to the apprehension of the writ petitioner. 
On the request of Mr. B. Gogoi, learned Standing Counsel, Health Department, Assam, this writ petition is directed to be listed again on 04/12/2024 for motion, as a fixed item. 
Two extra copies of the writ petition be furnished to Mr. Gogoi during the course of the day. As an ad-interim measure, it is hereby provided that till the next date fixed, the service of the petitioner shall not be disturbed in any manner.
